info.title: JanVaani API
info.description: Government circular simplification, translation, and audio platform

get.description:
Readiness check â verifies MongoDB and S3 connectivity.

Returns:
  status       â "ok" if all checks pass, "degraded" if any fail
  database     â "ready" | "unavailable"
  storage      â "s3" | "local" | "unavailable"
  s3_bucket    â bucket name when storage == "s3", null otherwise
Search published circulars with filters and pagination.

schema.title: Response Search Circulars Api Circulars Get

get.description: Get a single published circular by ID.

schema.title: Response Get Circular Api Circulars  Circular Id  Get

get.description: Get the approved translation for a circular in the given language.

schema.title: Response Get Translation Api Circulars  Circular Id  Translations  Language  Get

get.description:
Get a signed audio playback URL for the given circular and language.

Returns {"audio_available": false, "text_available": true} when no audio
exists yet or the language is not supported by Polly.

schema.title: Response Get Audio Api Circulars  Circular Id  Audio  Language  Get

get.description:
Return available filter values for the search UI.

Only aggregates from published circulars.

schema.title: Response Get Filters Api Catalogue Filters Get

post.description:
Trigger ingestion of a single government URL.

Validates URL against the allowlist before queuing.
Runs extraction as a background task â poll GET /{job_id} for status.

Returns 202 immediately with a job_id.

schema.title: Response Ingest Url Api Admin Ingestions Url Post

post.description:
Ingest pasted government text directly â no network fetch.

Builds a full CanonicalCircular from the provided text.
provenance.http_status and raw_*_s3_key will be null (correct â there
was no HTTP fetch).

Returns 202 immediately with a job_id.

schema.title: Response Ingest Text Api Admin Ingestions Text Post

get.description:
Poll the status of an ingestion job.

Status values:
  pending   â queued, not yet started
  running   â background task in progress
  completed â circular written to Mongo (check processing_status field)
  failed    â unrecoverable error (check error field)

processing_status on completed jobs:
  extracted               â successfully extracted, ready for Team 3
  manual_review_required  â fetch was blocked; document needs manual attention

post.description:
Manually retry a failed ingestion job.

Only jobs with status='failed' can be retried.
Never retried automatically â this endpoint is the only retry path.

schema.title: Response Retry Ingestion Api Admin Ingestions  Job Id  Retry Post

get.description: Return all registered sources, sorted by name.

schema.title: Response List Sources Api Admin Sources Get

post.description:
Register a new source in the registry.

source_id must be unique. Returns 409 if already exists.

schema.title: Response Create Source Api Admin Sources Post

get.description: Get a single source by source_id.

schema.title: Response Get Source Api Admin Sources  Source Id  Get

patch.description:
Partially update a source configuration.

Accepts any subset of Source fields. source_id is immutable.
Returns the updated document.

schema.title: Response Update Source Api Admin Sources  Source Id  Patch

post.description:
Trigger a crawler run for the given source.

Validates:
  - Source exists and status == 'active'
  - crawl_policy.enabled == true

Runs as a BackgroundTask. Returns run_id immediately for polling.

schema.title: Response Trigger Crawl Api Admin Sources  Source Id  Crawl Post

get.description:
Get the status and telemetry for a specific crawl run.

Status values: pending | running | completed | failed

schema.title: Response Get Crawl Run Api Admin Crawl Runs  Run Id  Get

get.description:
Telemetry summary for a source: recent crawl runs + document counts.

Returns:
  - recent_runs: last `limit` crawl runs (newest first)
  - total_circulars: total docs ingested from this source
  - extracted_count: docs with status='extracted'
  - manual_review_count: docs needing manual attention
  - last_run_at: timestamp of the most recent completed run

schema.title: Response Get Source Telemetry Api Admin Sources  Source Id  Telemetry Get

get.description: List processing jobs with filters and pagination.

schema.title: Response List Jobs Api Admin Jobs  Get

get.description: Get a single job by ID.

schema.title: Response Get Job Api Admin Jobs  Job Id  Get

post.description:
Retry a failed job.

Resets status to 'pending' and increments the attempt counter.
Re-enqueuing is handled by the worker polling this collection.

schema.title: Response Retry Job Api Admin Jobs  Job Id  Retry Post

post.description: Cancel a pending or running job.

schema.title: Response Cancel Job Api Admin Jobs  Job Id  Cancel Post

get.description:
Get the review queue with filters and pagination.

Joins each review with its circular's identity/source fields for display.

schema.title: Response List Reviews Api Admin Reviews  Get

get.description: Get a single review item with the associated circular and translation.

schema.title: Response Get Review Api Admin Reviews  Review Id  Get

patch.description:
Save reviewer edits to a translation.

Sets review status to 'in_review' and stores the edited fields.
Only non-None fields in the request body are updated.

schema.title: Response Save Edits Api Admin Reviews  Review Id  Patch

post.description:
Request AI to redraft the translation with reviewer feedback.

1. Marks review status as 'changes_requested'
2. Fetches the circular's original text
3. Re-runs simplification with the feedback appended
4. Creates a new Translation revision
5. Updates the review to point at the new translation

schema.title: Response Request Redraft Api Admin Reviews  Review Id  Redraft Post

post.description:
Approve a translation for publication.

THIS IS THE ONLY ENDPOINT THAT CAN SET published=True.

1. Sets review.status = 'approved'
2. Copies reviewer edits into the Translation document
3. Sets translation.status = 'approved'
4. If ALL translations for the circular are approved â sets circular.processing.published = True

schema.title: Response Approve Review Api Admin Reviews  Review Id  Approve Post

post.description: Reject a translation with a mandatory reason.

schema.title: Response Reject Review Api Admin Reviews  Review Id  Reject Post

post.description: Flag a review item for audit attention.

schema.title: Response Flag Review Api Admin Reviews  Review Id  Flag Post
